modified_card_json.name: Salvage Forager
modified_card_json.text:
When Salvage Forager enters the battlefield, choose one —
• Return target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
• Return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand. Delirium — If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, return that card to the battlefield tapped instead.
